name: 郑州风云3
english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Invincible Under Heaven' (the collector-assigned title 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' names this particular server instance). Part of the Fengyun ('Storm') engine family, alongside this collection's fy2/fy2005/fengyun434/moniHuafu, and — a relationship neither archive previously documented — a near-duplicate of this collection's other 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' entry, zzfy3: the two work trees are 10,345 files each and only 163 differ, and both in turn share the same 'Zhengzhou Storm' map and marriage system (confirmed via a byte-identical d/marry/hongniang-zhang.lpc matchmaker NPC) with this collection's wqfy ('Heartless Storm', same 'Invincible Under Heaven' banner). The game bills itself as 'a MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels' — rather than the Jin Yong-flavored wuxia common elsewhere in this collection, it leans into Gu Long's brisk, devil-may-care style of jianghu storytelling. Character creation lets players choose an ethnicity (Han, Miao, Manchu, or Mongol), and the same underworld death/revival ritual found in zzfy3 — a five-stage dialogue with Judge Cui Jue at the gates of the underworld, with ghosts free to wander rather than being locked in place — is present here too.
